name: approvers
sql: CREATE TABLE approvers (vault BLOB NOT NULL, device BLOB NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,device))

name: approvers_expires
sql: CREATE INDEX approvers_expires ON approvers(expires)

name: blob_garbage
sql: CREATE TABLE blob_garbage (vault BLOB NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,hash))

name: blob_usage
sql: CREATE TABLE blob_usage (vault BLOB NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,hash))

name: blobs
sql: CREATE TABLE blobs (vault BLOB NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,hash))

name: buckets
sql: CREATE TABLE buckets (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, until REAL NOT NULL, strikes INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: buckets_until
sql: CREATE INDEX buckets_until ON buckets(until)

name: charges
sql: CREATE TABLE charges (receipt TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bucket TEXT NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL)

name: charges_at
sql: CREATE INDEX charges_at ON charges(at)

name: charges_bucket
sql: CREATE INDEX charges_bucket ON charges(bucket)

name: devices
sql: CREATE TABLE devices (vault BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id), id BLOB NOT NULL, unlocked REAL NOT NULL, fresh REAL NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL, grant BLOB, PRIMARY KEY(vault,id))

name: digests
sql: CREATE TABLE digests (vault BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id), digest BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,digest))

name: entries
sql: CREATE TABLE entries (vault BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id), seq TEXT NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,seq), UNIQUE(vault,hash))

name: headers
sql: CREATE TABLE headers (vault BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id), seq TEXT NOT NULL, hash BLOB NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL, files BLOB, PRIMARY KEY(vault,seq), UNIQUE(vault,hash))

name: headers_files
sql: CREATE INDEX headers_files ON headers(vault,files)

name: lists
sql: CREATE TABLE lists (vault BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id), hash BLOB NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL, permanent INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,hash))

name: mailboxes
sql: CREATE TABLE mailboxes (number INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, vault BLOB NOT NULL, device BLOB NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL)

name: nonces
sql: CREATE TABLE nonces (device BLOB NOT NULL, nonce BLOB NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(device,nonce))

name: nonces_expires
sql: CREATE INDEX nonces_expires ON nonces(expires)

name: openings
sql: CREATE TABLE openings (vault BLOB NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL)

name: sessions
sql: CREATE TABLE sessions (vault BLOB NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, device BLOB NOT NULL, purpose TEXT NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,kind,device,purpose))

name: sessions_expires
sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_expires ON sessions(expires)

name: setup
sql: CREATE TABLE setup (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), bytes BLOB NOT NULL)

name: slots
sql: CREATE TABLE slots (number INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mailboxes(number) ON DELETE CASCADE, slot TEXT NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(number,slot))

name: state
sql: CREATE TABLE state (vault BLOB NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, key BLOB NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,kind,key))

name: vaults
sql: CREATE TABLE vaults (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY, head BLOB, active INTEGER NOT NULL, frozen INTEGER NOT NULL, moved BLOB, refused INTEGER NOT NULL, period REAL, repair BLOB, restored BLOB, progress BLOB)

name: versions
sql: CREATE TABLE versions (vault BLOB NOT NULL, list BLOB NOT NULL, file BLOB NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL, blob BLOB, tombstone INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(vault,list,file), FOREIGN KEY(vault,list) REFERENCES lists(vault,hash) ON DELETE CASCADE)
